feeds.title: Horticulture Connected
feeds.description: Read the latest news, analysis, and trends in landscape, garden retail & edible horticulture. HorticultureConnected Ltd (formerly HortiTrends) is an Irish company dedicated to the online and offline marketing of companies in the Horticulture, Landscape & Fresh Produce Sectors.

feeds.title: Growtrade
feeds.description: Growtrade is Ireland's newest online magazine for the horticultural trade industry.

feeds.title: National Botanic Gardens of Ireland Blog
feeds.description: This is a round-up of news stories from the National Botanic Gardens. The Mission of the National Botanic Gardens is to ensure that plant diversity is cherished and nourished in Ireland and throughout the world as our greatest renewable natural resource.

feeds.title: The Garden
feeds.description: Since studying horticulture at university, Mark has worked in London, Sydney, New York, and across Ireland, as a landscape and floral designer for both private and commercial clients. The Garden is a creative floral design studio, flower, and plant shop marrying the wilds of Connemara with the elegance of our Georgian surroundings.

feeds.title: betterplants.ie Blog
feeds.description: We source all our seaweed from Irish suppliers and make sure they are a 100% Natural product. We have been using seaweed products in our garden. Keeping our soil and plants chemical-free is key to growing better plants and crops. Our range of fertilizers is perfect for all your plants and crops needs.

feeds.title: Master My Garden
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to Master My Garden. My name is John Jones and I live in a country area in Co Laois, Ireland called Crettyard. I live here with my wife Rebecca and my two beautiful daughters Freya and Emmie. Helping you master your own garden.

feeds.title: Mount Venus Nursery
feeds.description: Mount Venus Nursery is a specialist nursery tucked away in the scenic Dublin hills overlooking the city. Over the past 20 years, we have been growing one of the widest collections of hardy garden plants in Ireland. Most of our plants are homegrown and exposed to the elements.

feeds.title: Future Forests
feeds.description: Future Forests is a family-run business with a passion for growing and our environment, and one of the leading mail-order plant providers in Ireland. With our roots firmly planted in the wilds of West Cork, we have been inspired to work alongside our unique environmental heritage to evolve an ethical business where our values and ethos lead the way.

feeds.title: Plant Store Blog
feeds.description: The Plant Store offers a unique range of indoor and outdoor plants, available online. We also offer a range of employee gardening workshops and offer installation, designed to improve team morale, wellness, and productivity!

feeds.title: Little Green Growers Blog
feeds.description: We are a young husband & wife team of organic farmers, following our dream on the Wild Atlantic Way. We will be there for you for growing advice every step of the way to harvest day through our website. Our mission is to make it easy to grow sustainable food & flowers at home.

feeds.title: Flower Child
feeds.description: My name is Alexandria Kelly. My hobbies are always evolving and my interests expanding. I love learning, so trying new things and exploring different adventures is my daily life. This blog plans to take you on a journey through the DIY life and garden projects here at Turra Lodge Farm. I also plan to post any other notable events or happenings so make sure to subscribe for updates.
